map.输入或粘贴 BIC/SWIFT 代码查询银行名称与国家，也可反向按行名检索代码，: Enter or paste a BIC/SWIFT code to look up the bank name and country, or reverse-search the code by bank name; for cross-border remittance form checks, a pure front-end table lookup.
map.基于 BIC/SWIFT 代码结构（4 位银行码 + 2 位国家码 + 2 位位: Based on the BIC/SWIFT structure (4-digit bank code + 2-digit country code + 2-digit location code + optional 3-digit branch code), look up bank and country; built-in common institution codes, for cross-border remittance form checks, pure front-end, no network.
map.跨境汇款填单时核对收款行：把银行提供的 BIC 贴入，确认 4 位银行码对应的机: When filling in a cross-border remittance form, paste the bank's BIC and check that the 4-digit bank code and country code match the beneficiary bank's institution and location.
map.拆解 BIC 四段：8 位 = 银行码(4) + 国家码(2) + 位置码(2): Break a BIC into four parts: 8 digits = bank code (4) + country code (2) + location code (2); an 11-digit BIC adds a 3-digit branch code. The page explains each segment.
map.判断是否需 11 位分支码：若收款行要求区分具体分行，核对末尾是否有 3 位分行: Decide whether an 11-digit branch code is needed: if the beneficiary bank requires a specific branch, check for the trailing 3-digit branch code and avoid using the 8-digit head-office code by mistake.
map.8 位和 11 位 BIC 有什么区别？: What is the difference between 8- and 11-digit BICs?
map.8 位是机构主码（银行 4 + 国家 2 + 位置 2），11 位在其后追加 3: An 8-digit BIC is the institution code (4 bank + 2 country + 2 location); an 11-digit BIC appends a 3-digit branch code. A trailing XXX usually means the head office, not a specific branch.
map.离线库收录多少银行？查不到怎么办？: How many banks are in the offline database, and what if mine is missing?
map.本页离线库仅含 33 家常见机构，用于快速定位，并非完整注册名录。查不到时不代表: This page's offline database contains only 33 common institutions for quick lookup and is not a complete registry. A miss does not mean the BIC is invalid; verify via SWIFT's official website (swift.com BIC search) or contact the beneficiary bank.
map.结果可以直接用于正式业务吗？: Can the result be used directly for official business?
map.不建议直接使用，正式业务应结合原始凭据、适用规则和人工复核。: Not recommended for direct use; official business should combine original documents, applicable rules and human review.

map.BIC 拆分：前 4 位银行代码（必须为大写字母，查离线库）、第 5–6 位国家: BIC breakdown: first 4 characters = bank code (must be uppercase letters, looked up in the offline database), characters 5-6 = country code (ISO 3166-1), characters 7-8 = location code, characters 9-11 = branch code; total length must be 8 or 11, and fewer than 8 characters prompts you to keep typing
